summary: First E2E test run for Arif Jewellers PWA. Backend: 25 pytest tests passed, 1 skipped (goldprice.org external 502 — auth-gating still verified). Frontend: all critical flows verified (splash bypass, home content with 'Since 1988' tagline, live rates card, language RTL switching EN/UR/SD, bottom nav navigation, floating WhatsApp button linking to wa.me/923092276875, 10 categories on Collections, wishlist add/persist via localStorage + visible on /wishlist, inquiry form saves to DB and opens WA link, admin login shows toast on wrong password + navigates to dashboard on success, all 4 admin tabs (Products/Rates/Reviews/Inquiries) render with expected controls including 'API Suggest' button).

minor.issue: External goldprice.org returned 502 during test window — endpoint auth-gating (401 for unauthenticated) verified. Not a code bug.

critical_code_review_comments: Cookie-based auth uses samesite='none' + secure=True which is correct for cross-site preview URLs. localStorage token fallback also present via axios interceptor. Both work.
server.py is 506 lines — within limit but consider splitting into modules (auth.py, products.py, rates.py) if it grows further.
seed_defaults() correctly resyncs admin password hash when .env password changes — matches playbook requirement.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} everywhere.
bcrypt used correctly (hash starts with $2b$); JWT HS256 with 12h expiry.
No rate-limiting / brute-force lockout implemented on /api/auth/login. Playbook mentions '5-fails lockout' — recommended to add (not blocking for MVP).
seed_data_creation: During UI test created and cleaned up one TEST_ product (id 09d90e10-…), one TEST_UI_Buyer inquiry, and one TEST_ review — all removed after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Splash lasts 5s; bypass with sessionStorage.setItem('arif_splash_seen','1') via add_init_script. Admin token stored in localStorage as 'arif_admin_token'; cookies also set (samesite=none, secure=true). External API /api/rates/api-suggestion may return 502 when goldprice.org is down — mark as pass if auth 401 works. wishlist-toggle only appears inside a ProductCard, so seed a product with featured=true or new_arrival=true first if you need to test the heart toggle.
